items.headline:
Market selloffs are becoming increasingly selective:

Over the last 20 S&P 500 down days, an average of 239 stocks finished positive, the highest reading on record.

This is TRIPLE the levels seen during the 2022 bear market and nearly double the 20-year average of 133 stocks.
